data.long_meaning: The name Jaspreet is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is composed of two parts: 'Jas' meaning 'God' and 'Preet' meaning 'precious gift'. This name is a reminder of the divine blessings bestowed upon us by the Almighty. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaspreet usually hope their child will grow to embody god's precious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Jaspreet Kaur was a prominent Sikh activist and political figure in the late 1970s and early 1980s during the Sikh separatist movement in Punjab, India. She was the president of the Damdama Taksal, a religious and educational institution, and a leader of the Shiromani Akali Dal, a major Sikh political party.
historical_references.context: Sikh separatist movement in Punjab, India

historical_references.reference: Jaspreet Singh is a well-known Indian-American entrepreneur, angel investor, and philanthropist. He is the founder and CEO of TiE Silicon Valley, the largest startup community in the world, and is a founding partner of Lightspeed India Partners, an early-stage venture capital firm. He was born in India in the 1960s and came to the United States to pursue higher education.
